c0000005-0000-4000-8000-000000000005.name: Lake Salda Ophiolite Rim to Lacustrine Terrace Transect
c0000005-0000-4000-8000-000000000005.geologicalRationale: Crosses from the surrounding Cretaceous harzburgite ophiolite rim down across ancient wave-cut terraces and modern hydromagnesite stromatolite shoreline into the lake basin (direct analog for Jezero delta margin).
c0000005-0000-4000-8000-000000000005.sourceDataset: Copernicus Global 90m Digital Elevation Model (COP-DEM-GLO-90) & SRTMGL1

c0000006-0000-4000-8000-000000000006.name: Great Rift Cinder Cones to Basalt Flow Transect
c0000006-0000-4000-8000-000000000006.geologicalRationale: Crosses Big Craters cinder cone scarp and descends onto jagged aa block lava flows and Indian Tunnel lava tube roof (analog for lunar mare and basaltic lava tubes).
c0000006-0000-4000-8000-000000000006.sourceDataset: Copernicus Global 90m Digital Elevation Model (COP-DEM-GLO-90) & SRTMGL1

c0000007-0000-4000-8000-000000000007.name: Askja Caldera Rim to Holuhraun Basalt Plain Transect
c0000007-0000-4000-8000-000000000007.geologicalRationale: Traverses Askja caldera rim, Öskjuvatn crater scarp, across basaltic tephra pumice plains, descending to the 2014-2015 Holuhraun fissure flood basalt field (Apollo astronaut training site).
c0000007-0000-4000-8000-000000000007.sourceDataset: Copernicus Global 90m Digital Elevation Model (COP-DEM-GLO-90) & ArcticDEM

c0000008-0000-4000-8000-000000000008.name: Peña de Hierro Gossan Ridge to River Canyon Transect
c0000008-0000-4000-8000-000000000008.geologicalRationale: Descends from oxidized ferric gossan ridge through historic open-pit terraces into the hyper-acidic river channel enriched in jarosite and hematite spherules (analog for Meridiani Planum).
c0000008-0000-4000-8000-000000000008.sourceDataset: Copernicus Global 90m Digital Elevation Model (COP-DEM-GLO-90) & SRTMGL1

c0000001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.name: Cordillera de la Sal Scarp to Yungay Basin Transect
c0000001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.geologicalRationale: Descends from gypsum-bearing Cordillera de la Sal scarp into hyper-arid Yungay alluvial basin floor characterized by extreme perchlorate soil chemistry.
c0000001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.sourceDataset: Copernicus Global 90m Digital Elevation Model (COP-DEM-GLO-90) & SRTMGL1

c0000004-0000-4000-8000-000000000004.name: Asgard Range to Taylor Valley Permafrost Floor Transect
c0000004-0000-4000-8000-000000000004.geologicalRationale: Descends from glaciated Asgard Range bedrock down through patterned permafrost ground to the Lake Bonney valley floor (cold-arid Mars cryosphere analog).
c0000004-0000-4000-8000-000000000004.sourceDataset: Copernicus Global 90m Digital Elevation Model (COP-DEM-GLO-90) & REMA

c0000003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003.name: Haughton Northwest Rim to Impact Basin Floor Transect
c0000003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003.geologicalRationale: Crosses shattered dolomite/limestone crater rim down into central impact melt breccia sheet and hydrothermal paleolake deposits.
c0000003-0000-4000-8000-000000000003.sourceDataset: Copernicus Global 90m Digital Elevation Model (COP-DEM-GLO-90) & CDEM

c0000002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002.name: Puʻu Poliʻahu Cinder Cone to Alpine Moraine Transect
c0000002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002.geologicalRationale: Traverses steep oxidized basaltic cinder cone scarp and alpine glacial moraines composed of tholeiitic and hawaiitic basaltic regolith (lunar regolith simulant analog).
c0000002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002.sourceDataset: Copernicus Global 90m Digital Elevation Model (COP-DEM-GLO-90) & USGS 3DEP
